_comment: Copy to config.json (same dir as driver.py, or point $RUN_TS_FINDER_CONFIG at it) and edit for your site. Every key is optional; CLI flags override config, config overrides built-in defaults. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_gxtb: g-xTB-enabled xtb binary: a name on PATH or an absolute path. MUST be an analytic-gradient build (g-xTB v2.0.0+) — confirm with `driver.py setup-gxtb`. Env var $GXTB overrides.
_gsm_infra: Directory containing the molecularGSM `gsm.orca` binary and `tm2orca.py` (https://github.com/ZimmermanGroup/molecularGSM). An `inpfileq_template` here overrides the bundled one. Env var $GSM_INFRA overrides.
_extra_lib_paths: Prepended to LD_LIBRARY_PATH when running gsm.orca / g-xTB (e.g. the MKL lib dir your gsm.orca build links against).
_defaults: System defaults; always overridable per run with --charge/--mult/--nnodes.
_routes: Project level of theory. `refine --route` overrides per run. If the Gaussian route uses gen/pseudo=read you must append basis/ECP blocks to the generated input by hand (the driver warns).
gaussian_route: #p B3LYP/def2SVP EmpiricalDispersion=GD3BJ Int=UltraFine SCF=(MaxCycle=512,XQC) Opt=(TS,CalcFC,NoEigen,MaxCycles=200) Freq
orca_route: ! B3LYP D3BJ def2-SVP def2/J OptTS NumFreq
_submit: Shell templates run (in a login shell, from the input's directory) by `--submit`. Placeholders: {input} = input basename, {dir}, {mem}, {cpus}, {queue}. Leave empty to have the driver just write inputs and print them.
_scheduler: Batch system for `escalate` job scaffolds: pbs or slurm.
